reasoning_traces.think:
The system maintains two distinct enforcement layers: a CI guardrail that scans specific paths and a runtime agent check that validates semantic intent. These operate independently, allowing a script to publish content even though neither CI nor agent logic permits it directly. The contradiction resolves through path segregation—publishing occurs outside the guardrail’s scope, while agent checks remain intact. This creates a dual-state system where the repository contains both a functional no-publish rule and a live public surface. The failure mode arises when a new path enters the system without being added to either layer, leading to unintended exposure.
